well.reason: Illustrative design values; no measured well is represented. Rod order is surface first; lengths ft, diameters in, weights lb/ft, moduli psi.

resolved_context_defaults.reason: All unspecified context, rod, pump and surface-unit fields retain model defaults; no survey or well test was supplied.

stroke_in.reason: Dimensionless source has no measured stroke.

minimum_load_lbf.reason: Dimensionless source has no measured load datum.

load_range_lbf.reason: Fo = (pi/4 * 1.5^2) * (63.237 * 4844 / 144 + 100); common static fluid-load scale at zero intake pressure.

scale_intake_pressure_psi.reason: Defines only the static load scale; computed CPIP need not be zero.

card_space.reason: Source does not identify surface or pump space.

value.preparation: closed, uniform normalised Euclidean arc length, clockwise, renormalised

sampling.reason: Arc-length samples are treated as uniformly timed; measured kinematics are unavailable.

surface_card.reason: Forward rod-string model, not a measured polished-rod card.

crosswalks.reason: Supply insufficiency does not establish fluid pound; sand production does not establish abrasion.

uniform_scale.value: All ten shapes use the same stroke and load range
uniform_scale.reason: Rod parting and other near-zero physical-load conditions are shape illustrations, not physical pump cards.

cpip_defaults.reason: CPIP derives density from this default mixture, not context fluid_density; retained as the module reports it.

production.reason: InputParameters defaults runtime to 24 h (reported source: card); no measured runtime or efficiency. Production = net displacement * runtime / 24; reported efficiency is not a multiplier.

solver_defaults.reason: Forward and default inverse use matching grids, damping defaults and vertical survey; inverse output smoothing remains enabled.
